_comment: TOOL is public source code and documentation.
FIXTURE is synthetic test data generated by tools/make_fixtures.py.
DATA is real runtime output in a PRIVATE versioned companion repository.
Real DATA never exists in this public source tree, including ignored paths.
_audited: Capability repair audited store, worker evidence, run logs, ingest cursors/inboxes, registry writes, digest records, and verification scripts. Every writer proves the nearest governing repository PRIVATE before creating output; nested and linked repositories use Git resolution. Explicit database paths do not bypass this proof.
_data_home: SCHEDULE_REMINDER_DATA_DIR or the data directory of SCHEDULE_REMINDER_CONFIG. PRIVATE companion DATA is versioned and backed up; PUBLIC, unknown and unmanaged destinations fail closed.
